candidates.claim: Clearing a custom range before the saved Default range is read returns the panel to the 7d placeholder, and rangePicked then stops the real default from ever applying to the shown range.
candidates.trigger: 1. Host settings.get('defaultRange') is slow (seconds; shell deadline 120 s, plugin-panel-shell.js:115). Saved default is 30d. Panel opens, firstLoad starts readDefaultRange (state.defaultRange still the initial '7d', panel.js:9). 2. User clicks Custom (ranges handler sets state.rangePicked = true, panel.js:843), enters dates, Apply: applyDates sets range 'custom', rangePicked, load() (panel.js:295-299). 3. User clicks the custom chip clear (chip at panel.js:128, handler panel.js:913) or Reset all (panel.js:910) while read still out. 4. clearFilter: state.range = state.defaultRange = '7d' (panel.js:158), load() fetches 7d. 5. Read answers '30d': readDefaultRange sets state.defaultRange = '30d' (panel.js:629). firstLoad resumes: rangePicked true, so no move (panel.js:605); report stays 7d, radio shows 7d. Clearing a custom range should return to 30d.
candidates.path: src/panel/panel.js:158 -> src/panel/panel.js:9 (placeholder) ; src/panel/panel.js:843/295 (rangePicked) ; src/panel/panel.js:605 (no move) ; src/panel/panel.js:629 (late write, unused)
candidates.confidence: medium; needs a settings read slower than the user's Custom->Apply->clear sequence. No test covers clear before the read answers (tests/panel.test.mjs 'a Default range changed...' and 'an unknown or unreadable...' cover other paths). Settle by adding a test: pending get, Custom Apply, clear chip, then resolve get('30d'), expect last report 30d.
candidates.class: reads a value that is still in flight (placeholder initial value) on a consumer path that is not gated on the read, and the late write is then blocked by a 'user already decided' flag
candidates.sweep: Readers of state.defaultRange: only clearFilter (panel.js:158, checked-broken, this case) and firstLoad (panel.js:603, checked-fine because it waits on defaultRangeWaiters). Writers of state.range: panel.js:158 (broken path), 295 applyDates (picked, fine), 606 firstLoad (gated on rangePicked, fine), 855 ranges click (picked, fine). Writers of rangePicked: 296, 843 only; reader 605 only. Same clear in panel/index.html:1603 (checked-broken, identical copy). Chip render panel.js:128 shows only for custom (checked-fine).
